title: Queued Up: 2026 Edition - Characteristics of Power Plants Seeking Transmission Interconnection As of the End of 2025
summary: LBNL's national queue summary at end-2025; regional context for APS (non-ISO West). No APS-specific tables; APS project data is in the companion xlsx. 8,244 active requests (~2,061 GW) nationally, -10% in 2025; non-ISO West 957 active requests, 567.4 GW.

findings.statement: Nationally 8,244 active requests (~2,061 GW) at end-2025 across 7 ISO/RTOs and 47 non-ISO balancing areas; active capacity fell 10% in 2025; over 750 GW withdrawn in 2025.
The non-ISO West (which includes APS) had 957 active requests totalling 567.4 GW at end-2025, the largest region; 69 GW active with draft or executed IAs plus 11 GW suspended.
Most active solar capacity is in the Southwestern states; the West has the most active storage and wind.

open_questions: APS-specific completion/timeline statistics must be computed from the xlsx to compare with West medians.
model: external research session (queue + computed from LBNL data)
